_about: Spoken commentary clips, keyed by the commentary line keys in src/game/commentary.ts. Lines are generic (no player or team names) so they fit any match; the ticker text still carries the names. '...' marks a dramatic beat and each sentence is spoken as its own phrase with a short breath between, see build_commentary.py. score_* clips are built by the script.
kickoffFirst: The whistle goes... and we are under way!
Big match, this one. Let's go!
kickoffSecond: Right then... the second half is under way!
Orange slices eaten... second half, here we go!
kickoffAfterGoal: Back to the middle... and off we go again!
Deep breaths, everyone. Here we go again.
Kick off again... can they hit back?
goalOpener: Goal! The first goal of the game!
And it's in! They've opened the scoring!
goalEqualiser: They've levelled it up! What a reply!
Equaliser! We've got a game on!
goalLead: Goal! The keeper had no chance!
goalExtend: Goal! They're running away with this!
goalReply: They pull one back! Game on!
Goal! Is there a comeback on?
Oh, that gives them hope! Goal!
goalBrace: That's two for the striker! What a game they're having!
goalHatTrick: A hat-trick! Three goals! Someone give them the match ball!
goalLate: Late drama! Right at the death... Goal!
With the clock nearly up... it's in! Wow!
goalOwn: Oh no! Into their own net!
Oh, unlucky... it's an own goal!
Oh dear. That went the wrong way!
goalPenalty: Steps up... and scores! Cool as you like!
goalLongRange: Whoa! From miles out! What a hit!
Wow! What a screamer! From way out!
goalRocket: Rocket! Two points for that one!
Wow! Smashed it! A two pointer!
saveFromShooter: Whoa! What a save! Kept out!
missWide: Ohh, so close! Past the post.
missBar: Whoa! The bar is still shaking!
missPost: Ohh! Off the post! So unlucky!
foul: And the referee blows... that's a foul.
Ooh, that's a trip. Free kick.
penalty: Penalty! The referee points to the spot!
halftimeLevel: That's half time. Nothing between these two!
Half time... and it's all to play for!
halftimeLead: The referee blows for half time.
fulltimeDraw: There's the final whistle. Honours even!
fulltimeWin: It's all over! What a game!
fulltimeThrashing: It's all over! A huge win!
shootoutOver: The shoot-out is over! They've held their nerve!
It's all over... what a shoot-out!
trainingOver: That's the session done. Great work!
quietAttack: Oh, lots of space to run into!
quietDefence: Careful now... close to their own goal.
Looking for a way out of there.
quietKeeper: The keeper hasn't had much to do yet.
quietRain: The rain is really coming down now.
Slippery out there in the rain!
quietSnow: Snow on the pitch! Lovely stuff.
quietNight: Floodlights on... and it looks magical out there.
quietSunset: What a sunset over the pitch.
lastMinute: One minute left! Is there time for one more?
twoPlayer: Two players, one keyboard. Who's bossing it?
